attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 28, `pgl` to `cydA`, are carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 7% of calls. The model names 95 to 99% of them, fewest at column 26, `cydX`, 95%.

**A fork follows at columns 29 to 31**, carried by 28 to 62%, all shell, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 51 to 52%. A second branch of 3 families runs through those columns in 23 to 24%, `hypothetical protein` to `glmS`. Then the `sdh` genes, columns 36 to 39, [[succinate dehydrogenase]], and the `ybg` genes, columns 42 to 45, [[fimbrial biogenesis]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 89%, and hesitates less there, 0.21 against 0.54 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 62 to 79, `kdpC` to `glnS`, are carried by 31 to 89%, 13 persistent and 5 shell. The last column is `glnS`, in 46% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 94% of genes**, 0.32 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.00 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 77% against 97%.

label: pgl
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the pgl window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor pgl, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,984 to 3,063 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying pgl once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,822 calls, named 99%, 0.11 bits; shell 9,088 calls, named 77%, 1.01 bits; cloud 290 calls, named 10%, 3.85 bits. Outside an RGP 35,530 calls, named 97%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 7,670 calls, named 77%, 1.00 bits. Columns: 52 spine, 8 fork, 20 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.00 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (77% against 97%); 7,670 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 29 ("hypothetical protein", a fork column) 1.98 bits, RGP 51%; column 56 ("IS1 family transposase", a fork column) 1.28 bits, RGP 27%; column 57 (rhsC, a fork column) 1.07 bits, RGP 28%. The 10 columns (columns 29-32, 43-45 and 66-68) where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.64 bits on average; the other 70 columns: named 94%, 0.28 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 52 spine columns: named 96%, 0.21 bits on average; the 28 fork and variable columns: named 89%, 0.54 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 29, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 29-31 (fork), RGP 51-52%; the least: columns 0-28 (spine), RGP 2-7%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-28 (29 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 2-7%. Genes: pgl, ybhA "bifunctional pyridoxal phosphate/fr…", modC, modB "molybdate ABC transporter permease…", modA, acrZ, modE, modF "molybdate ABC transporter ATP-bindi…", galE "UDP-glucose 4-epimerase GalE", galT, galK, galM, gpmA, aroG, ybgS "YbgS-like family protein", zitB, pnuC, nadA, cpoB, pal, tolB "Tol-Pal system beta propeller repea…", tolA, tolR, tolQ, ybgC "tol-pal system-associated acyl-CoA…", ybgE "cyd operon protein YbgE", cydX, cydB, cydA "cytochrome ubiquinol oxidase subuni…". named 95-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 26 (cydX), named 95%; most hesitant at column 17 (nadA), 0.33 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 29-31 (3 columns) fork: share 28-62%, all S, RGP 51-52%. named 54-94% (mean 80%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 29, named 54%, 1.98 bits.
[S2.b29]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 29-31, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 23-24%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "hypothetical protein", glmS
[S2.c29]    29: "hypothetical protein" S 28%
[S2.c30]    30: mngA S 58%; also mngB S 57%
[S2.c31]    31: mngR S 62% "mannosyl-D-glycerate transport/meta…"
[S3] 3. columns 32-41 (10 columns) spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 16-52%. Genes: sucD, sucC "ADP-forming succinate--CoA ligase s…", odhB, sucA, sdhB, sdhA, sdhD, sdhC "succinate dehydrogenase cytochrome…", "hypothetical protein", gltA. named 89-98% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 41 (gltA), named 89%, 0.37 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 42-45 (4 columns) variable: share 70-77%, all S, RGP 37-57%. named 91-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 43, named 91%, 0.70 bits.
[S4.c42]    42: ybgD S 70% "fimbrial protein"
[S4.c43]    43: ybgQ S 70% "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher…"
[S4.c44]    44: ybgP S 77% "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone"
[S4.c45]    45: ybgO S 76% "fimbrial protein"
[S5] 5. columns 46-54 (9 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 4-27%. Genes: abrB, nei, pxpA "5-oxoprolinase subunit PxpA", pxpC, pxpB, ybgI "radiation resistance protein YbgI", dtpD, phrB, ybgA "YbgA family protein". named 92-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 51 (ybgI), named 92%; most hesitant at column 54 (ybgA), 0.46 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 55-57 (3 columns) fork: share 25-52%, all S, RGP 21-28%. named 75-82% (mean 79%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 56, named 75%, 1.28 bits.
[S6.c55]    55: ybfC S 52% "protein YbfC"; also "DUF6258 family protein" S 10%
[S6.c56]    56: "IS1 family transposase" S 25%; also "NTF2 fold immunity protein" S 13%
[S6.c57]    57: rhsC S 48%; also ybfB S 38%
[S7] 7. columns 58-61 (4 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 8-27%. Genes: ybfA "YbfA family protein", kdpF "K(+)-transporting ATPase subunit F", kdpA, kdpB. named 87-94% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 58 (ybfA), named 87%, 0.74 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 62-79 (18 columns) fork and variable columns: share 31-89%, 13 P, 5 S, RGP 5-55%. named 85-96% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 64, named 85%, 0.78 bits.
[S8.c62]    62 variable: kdpC P 89%
[S8.c63]    63 variable: kdpD P 88%
[S8.c64]    64 variable: kdpE P 88%
[S8.c65]    65 variable: "TonB-dependent receptor" S 31%
[S8.c66]    66 fork: speFL S 74%; also speF S 64%
[S8.c67-78]    columns 67-78 variable, share 49-86%, 9 P, 3 S: potE 72%, "DUF2625 domain-containing protein" 49%, "lipoprotein" 61%, pgm 86%, seqA 86%, ybfF "esterase" 85%, ybfE "LexA regulated protein" 83%, fldA 79%, uof 75%, fur 71%, chiQ 67%, chiP "chitoporin ChiP" 53%
[S8.c79]    79 fork: glnS P 46%; also nagE P 25%, nagB P 14%
